notes.title: Significant Update: English Voice-Over, Polishing Overhaul, Balancing, and More!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40027441/7ca2a3b84a9d93c40e403564089e67080603201a.png[/img]

Thank you for playing [b]Snake Man's Adventure[/b]! This update represents my most substantial effort yet, enhancing various aspects of the game. Its primary focus is on [b]polish[/b] and [b]quality[/b], but it also introduces improvements in [b]accessibility[/b] and [b]game balance[/b]. To emphasize the importance of this update, I've chosen to rename the game. Welcome to [b]Dosoland: Snake Man's Adventure[/b]! 🎮🐍

[b]Detailed Change Log:[/b]

[list]
[*] Various level design balancing Improvements 
[*] Full English voice-over
[*] Various new background animations / effects (e.g. moving clouds, twinkling stars, heat haze)
[*] More and better particle effects  
[*] Added character shadows
[*] New animated title screen image, improved intro images
[*] Improved introduction level (graphics and level design) 
[*] Improved jungle level tileset design
[*] Added an optional timer to support speedruns
[*] Added possibility to look up and down
[*] Added additional animations for Snake Man (e.g. talking, idle, balance)
[*] Improved the design of Doggo's ship
[*] Improved controller support, now also supporting Playstation controllers and others
[*] Added option to change the language directly from the options menu
[*] Added enemy knockback animation
[*] Various additional animations for the UI and the ingame action  
[*] Added support for lower resolution devices, such as the Steam Deck
[*] Improved end boss fight with new music and adjusted gameplay
[*] Additional sound effects (e.g. reverb effect in caves) 
[*] New and improved UI elements (like button prompts)
[/list]

Please note that save states from the previous version will not be compatible, so it is necessary to start a new game. Thank you for your understanding!
